statement.name: AllIndexes
statement.sql:
i.Name AS 'DisplayText', i.[Key] AS 'Key', i.URL AS 'Url', g.ID, g.Name
FROM PFM_ENSR_Indexes AS i JOIN PFM_ENSR_IndexGroups AS g ON i.GroupId = g.ID

statement.name: GetIndexFacets
statement.sql:
r.DisplayText, r.Field, f.Name -- FacetType
FROM PFM_ENSR_RefinedByFacets AS r JOIN PFM_ENSR_Indexes AS i ON r.[Index] = i.ID JOIN PFM_ENSR_FacetTypes AS f ON f.ID = r.FacetType
